evals.name: family-controls-authorization-and-picker
evals.prompt: Create an iOS SwiftUI view and manager that requests FamilyControls authorization for an individual user, presents the FamilyActivityPicker modal, and saves the opaque FamilyActivitySelection to shared App Group UserDefaults.
evals.expected_output: SwiftUI code integrating AuthorizationCenter.shared.requestAuthorization(for: .individual), familyActivityPicker, and App Group persistence using PropertyListEncoder.
assertions: Uses the .familyActivityPicker(isPresented:selection:) view modifier to allow app and domain selection.
Encodes FamilyActivitySelection with PropertyListEncoder for persistence.
Stores the serialized selection in an App Group suite of UserDefaults so extensions can access it.

evals.name: managed-settings-shield-application
evals.prompt: Write a Swift service that uses ManagedSettings to apply shields to selected applications, categories, and web domains, and provides a method to clear all applied restrictions.
evals.expected_output: A ManagedSettings service creating a named ManagedSettingsStore, assigning shielded application, category, and web domain tokens, and exposing clearAllSettings.
assertions: Initializes a ManagedSettingsStore with an optional identifier.
Sets store.shield.applications to the selected application tokens.
Sets store.shield.webDomains to the selected web domain tokens.
Provides a clear method calling store.clearAllSettings() to unshield apps.

evals.name: device-activity-schedule-monitoring
evals.prompt: Show how to set up a DeviceActivitySchedule with warningTime, create a threshold event for app usage, and start background monitoring with DeviceActivityCenter.
evals.expected_output: Code defining a DeviceActivitySchedule with start and end DateComponents, configuring a DeviceActivityEvent with threshold, and calling startMonitoring.
assertions: Initializes a DeviceActivitySchedule specifying intervalStart and intervalEnd DateComponents.
Defines a DeviceActivityEvent with application tokens and a duration threshold.
Provides a corresponding stopMonitoring call to cease monitoring.

evals.name: shield-action-and-configuration-extension
evals.prompt: Implement a custom ShieldConfigurationExtension subclassing ShieldConfigurationDataSource and a ShieldActionExtension subclassing ShieldActionDelegate to provide custom shield branding and handle button actions.
evals.expected_output: Subclasses of ShieldConfigurationDataSource returning custom ShieldConfiguration styling and ShieldActionDelegate responding to primary/secondary button presses.
assertions: Subclasses ShieldConfigurationDataSource and overrides configuration(shielding: Application).
Returns a ShieldConfiguration with title, subtitle, and button styling.
Calls completionHandler with appropriate ShieldActionResponse like .close or .defer.
